product_risk_or_requirement: Healthcare AI high-risk classification under Vietnam AI Law 134/2025/QH15 and Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg
current_state: Law is enacted but specific healthcare AI requirements need mapping
product_requirement: Complete regulatory classification that formally maps each MediCare+ feature to the applicable high-risk AI categories
acceptance_criteria: Given the MediCare+ product scope When regulatory classification review is conducted by legal counsel Then official documentation formally maps each feature to Vietnam AI Law requirements
owner: VP of Healthcare Product and Legal Counsel
evidence_needed: Completed regulatory classification memo signed by qualified legal counsel

product_risk_or_requirement: EU AI Act Annex III conformity assessment for high-risk healthcare AI
current_state: EU requirements require separate comprehensive assessment by qualified notified body
product_requirement: Conformity assessment demonstrating compliance with EU AI Act requirements including risk management and quality management
acceptance_criteria: Given the MediCare+ EU market entry plan When conformity assessment is initiated Then evidence package includes all required documentation per Annex III and IV requirements
owner: EU Compliance Lead and External Legal Counsel
evidence_needed: Conformity assessment report by notified body and technical documentation

product_risk_or_requirement: Physician oversight protocol with defined escalation paths and documentation requirements
current_state: Law requires human oversight but specific implementation is not yet defined
product_requirement: Written physician oversight protocol defining which recommendations require physician review and response time SLAs
acceptance_criteria: Given a user interaction resulting in high-urgency recommendation When the recommendation is generated Then a physician reviewer receives notification within 15 minutes for red urgency
evidence_needed: Signed physician oversight protocol document and training completion records

product_risk_or_requirement: Adverse event response procedure for AI-related patient safety incidents
current_state: Regulations require adverse event reporting but specific AI procedures are not defined
product_requirement: Documented adverse event response procedure covering identification criteria and immediate response protocols
acceptance_criteria: Given a potential AI-related safety incident When clinical team identifies the incident Then response protocol activates within 1 hour with incident documentation within 24 hours
owner: Risk Management Lead and Regulatory Affairs
evidence_needed: Completed adverse event response procedure and tabletop exercise simulation

product_risk_or_requirement: Bias testing and fairness validation ensuring demographic parity across all protected groups
current_state: Bias risk identified but no systematic testing implemented
product_requirement: Comprehensive bias testing protocol completed before any model deployment and with every significant model update
acceptance_criteria: Given a new model version When pre-deployment bias testing is conducted Then bias testing report demonstrates no statistically significant disparity exceeding 5 percentage points
owner: Healthcare AI Ethics Board and Data Science Lead
evidence_needed: Comprehensive bias testing methodology and statistical analysis plan

product_risk_or_requirement: Medication database RAG implementation eliminating hallucination risk
current_state: AI hallucination risk identified but no retrieval architecture implemented
product_requirement: Implement retrieval-augmented generation for all medication queries from validated databases with source citation
acceptance_criteria: Given a medication information query When user requests drug interactions Then the response contains only database-verified content with source citations
owner: Technical Product Owner and Chief Medical Officer
evidence_needed: Technical architecture documentation and zero-hallucination test results

product_risk_or_requirement: Patient data privacy and consent framework compliant with GDPR and Vietnamese privacy law
current_state: GDPR and Vietnamese privacy law requirements apply but consent mechanism not fully defined
product_requirement: Patient consent and data protection framework that obtains explicit informed consent before any data collection
acceptance_criteria: Given a user accessing MediCare+ When personal health information is collected Then explicit informed consent is obtained in clear language
owner: Data Protection Officer and Legal Counsel
evidence_needed: Completed data protection impact assessment and consent flow user interface

product_risk_or_requirement: Model transparency and explainability for triage recommendations
current_state: Current model provides outputs without sufficient explanation
product_requirement: Implement model transparency including confidence score display and clear disclaimer about AI limitations
acceptance_criteria: Given a triage recommendation is generated When user views the recommendation Then they can see confidence level and key factors and clear disclaimer
owner: Technical Product Owner and UX Lead
evidence_needed: User interface mockups demonstrating transparency features

product_risk_or_requirement: Post-market monitoring system for continuous model performance tracking
current_state: Initial monitoring defined but continuous surveillance system not implemented
product_requirement: Post-market monitoring system that tracks triage accuracy metrics and monitors demographic parity monthly
acceptance_criteria: Given MediCare+ is operating in production When user interactions occur Then real-time monitoring captures triage outcomes with automated alerting
owner: Data Science Lead and Healthcare AI Ethics Board
evidence_needed: Post-market monitoring system technical architecture and dashboard

product_risk_or_requirement: Algorithm change control plan defining how model updates are validated and deployed
current_state: Model update procedures not yet defined with governance controls
product_requirement: Algorithm change control plan that defines categories of model changes and validation requirements
acceptance_criteria: Given a model update is proposed When change control review is initiated Then classification of change type determines validation requirements
owner: Data Science Lead and Chief Medical Officer
evidence_needed: Algorithm change control plan document and validation requirements
